routes.id: Skills/Routes/A customer asks about your data handling
routes.name: A customer asks about your data handling

steps.does: Builds a data protection impact assessment in the structure the Information Commissioner's Office sets out, from what your vault already says about the data you hold. Writes it into Operations.
Walks you through the Cyber Essentials controls on your own computer and records the evidence in Operations. Nothing changes on your computer without your say.

Checks the opportunity against four walls before you spend a week on it: cyber, clearance, export and commercial basics. Reads your context and the defence reference, and writes a go or no-go page into the engagement folder.
Drafts the response against the published criteria, using your context, your services and the evidence in the engagement folder. Everything it produces stays in that folder.
Reads your last daily note, your live engagements and initiatives, the events coming up and the contacts going quiet, and writes today's note.
Sweeps the vault for pages that have gone stale or lost their place, and writes one short report into Operations. It is meant to run about once a month, not every week.

routes.name: You meet someone at an event

steps.does: Adds the organisation to your CRM from public information, under its parent where it has one, and asks you to confirm before it writes.
Prepares a briefing for the follow-up meeting from your CRM, your initiatives, the events you have logged and your context. It writes nothing; the briefing is given to you in the conversation.
